tactic.rabonaarena.balanced.desc: Neither high nor deep; mixes short and long passing.
tactic.rabonaarena.tiki_taka.desc: Keep the ball with short passes, probe patiently, press in pairs.
tactic.rabonaarena.gegenpress.desc: Swarm the ball with three players after losing it; very high line.
tactic.rabonaarena.counter.desc: Sit deep, break fast and direct when you win it; forwards stay high.
tactic.rabonaarena.park_bus.desc: Back five, narrow and compact; keeping a clean sheet comes first.
tactic.rabonaarena.wing_play.desc: Stretch the pitch; wingers go to the byline and cross.
tactic.rabonaarena.long_ball.desc: Skip midfield with long balls and crosses; shoot from distance.
move.rabonaarena.pass_short.desc: Quick, accurate ground pass to the best teammate in your view.
move.rabonaarena.pass_through.desc: Lead pass into a teammate's run that splits the defence. (Shift + Pass)
move.rabonaarena.pass_lob.desc: Long pass lifted over the defenders.
move.rabonaarena.pass_cross.desc: Curling cross that bends toward goal. (Shift + Lofted Pass)
move.rabonaarena.pass_backheel.desc: Stylish backheel to a teammate behind you.
move.rabonaarena.pass_nolook.desc: Look one way, pass the other. Confuses defenders. Use A/D for direction.
move.rabonaarena.pass_rabona.desc: Flashy cross with the kicking leg wrapped behind the standing leg. Grants energy.
move.rabonaarena.shot_power.desc: Full power! Faster the more you charge; overcharge ruins accuracy.
move.rabonaarena.shot_finesse.desc: Inside-foot curler that bends into the corner.
move.rabonaarena.shot_chip.desc: Soft lob over the goalkeeper. Deadly when the keeper is off his line.
move.rabonaarena.shot_trivela.desc: Outside-of-the-boot strike that curves the other way.
move.rabonaarena.shot_knuckle.desc: Spinless rocket that wobbles unpredictably. A keeper's nightmare.
move.rabonaarena.shot_rabona.desc: The legendary shot with crossed legs.
move.rabonaarena.shot_panenka.desc: Delicate dink down the middle while the keeper dives. Takes nerve.
move.rabonaarena.shot_deadleaf.desc: Struck through the middle: rises without spin and suddenly dips in front of goal. A free-kick weapon.
move.rabonaarena.shot_toepoke.desc: Instant toe-poke that catches the keeper unprepared.
move.rabonaarena.header.desc: Head the ball where you are looking.
move.rabonaarena.diving_header.desc: Throw yourself at the ball for a powerful header.
move.rabonaarena.volley.desc: Strike the ball out of the air before it lands.
move.rabonaarena.bicycle.desc: Acrobatic overhead kick. Press shoot while looking up at an airborne ball.
move.rabonaarena.scorpion.desc: Dive forward and strike over your head with your heels.
move.rabonaarena.chest_control.desc: Cushion an aerial ball on your chest and bring it down.
move.rabonaarena.rainbow.desc: Flick the ball from behind over your own head and the defender.
move.rabonaarena.elastico.desc: Push out, snap back in. Breaks ankles.
move.rabonaarena.roulette.desc: 360° spin over the ball to escape pressure.
move.rabonaarena.stepover.desc: Swing your leg over the ball and change direction.
move.rabonaarena.cruyff.desc: Fake a kick, drag the ball behind your standing leg and turn.
move.rabonaarena.dragback.desc: Roll the ball back with your sole to dodge a tackle.
move.rabonaarena.croqueta.desc: Quick side-shift of the ball between both feet.
move.rabonaarena.sombrero.desc: Flick the ball over the defender's head and collect behind him.
move.rabonaarena.nutmeg.desc: Slip the ball through the defender's legs and run around him.
move.rabonaarena.chop.desc: Sharp cut behind your standing leg.
move.rabonaarena.heel_flick.desc: Flick the ball up and forward with your heel.
move.rabonaarena.seal.desc: Run while bouncing the ball on your head. Very hard to steal.
move.rabonaarena.around_world.desc: Juggle the ball around your foot. Generates lots of energy.
move.rabonaarena.speed_burst.desc: Knock the ball ahead and sprint after it.
move.rabonaarena.body_feint.desc: Drop the shoulder one way, explode the other. The defender bites.
move.rabonaarena.celeb_shirt_off.desc: Rip the shirt off and wave it in the air!
move.rabonaarena.fake_shot.desc: Wind up and don't shoot! Keepers and defenders bite.
move.rabonaarena.tackle.desc: Win the ball from an opponent on your feet.
move.rabonaarena.slide.desc: Slide in to win the ball; flattens the carrier. (Sprint or Shift + Tackle)
move.rabonaarena.shoulder.desc: Muscle the opponent off the ball.
move.rabonaarena.gk_dive_left.desc: Keeper flies left to make the save.
move.rabonaarena.gk_dive_right.desc: Keeper flies right to make the save.
move.rabonaarena.gk_punt.desc: Boot the ball upfield from your hands.
move.rabonaarena.gk_throw.desc: Throw the ball to a teammate.
move.rabonaarena.celeb_siu.desc: Run, jump, spin in the air and land in the legendary pose!
move.rabonaarena.celeb_kneeslide.desc: Slide on your knees across the grass.
move.rabonaarena.celeb_plane.desc: Spread your arms and glide like a plane.
move.rabonaarena.celeb_dance.desc: A dance show for the fans.
move.rabonaarena.ab_fire.desc: SPECIAL: A missile in flames that knocks back the keeper. (100 energy)
move.rabonaarena.ab_thunder.desc: SPECIAL: Lightning strikes, insane speed for 6s. (60 energy)
move.rabonaarena.ab_tornado.desc: SPECIAL: Spin and strike; the ball twists like a cyclone. (100 energy)
move.rabonaarena.ab_ghost.desc: SPECIAL: 5s invisibility, tackles can't touch you. (60 energy)
move.rabonaarena.ab_magnet.desc: SPECIAL: Pull the ball to you, even from opponents. (50 energy)
move.rabonaarena.ab_ice.desc: SPECIAL: Stomp and freeze nearby opponents. (70 energy)
